prompts.title: A / WALNUT HERITAGE
prompts.direction: Warm traditional neighborhood craft shop. Moss-green painted timber storefront, warm ivory plaster single-storey body, restrained dark walnut cornice and a shallow weathered copper canopy, simple rectangular windows. Walnut glass counter, sage painted back cabinets, cream wall, honey oak plank floor, small collection of varied pendulum clocks on rear wall. Brass hardware and green felt repair mat. Quiet amber light and welcoming domestic craftsmanship. U-shaped retail cabinets at perimeter; workstation in back-right open alcove, low counter in front leaving left-side approach. Distinctive beautiful timber joinery, not crowded.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE premium landscape game environment concept design board, approximately 2048x1536, for a first-person Unity detective game. This is a NEW clock and wristwatch shop concept, not a screenshot or a remodel of the reference.
Input images: the town and room reference images are ONLY guidance for broad stylized shapes, cool gray-blue/violet shadows and warm interior lighting. Upgrade craft and beauty with beveled modular geometry and selective tactile materials. Do not copy their composition or UI.
Setting: a fictional small town in the game's 1931 setting. A small independent watchmaker shop, human scale, NOT a palace, mall or huge showroom.
Shared physical requirements: one functional storey only; roughly 8.2m street frontage by 7.4m depth; centered front entrance, exactly one generous display window each side of it; both front windows and the entrance correspond exactly in the external render, internal render and cutaway. No fake upper-floor windows, no extra floors, no stairs. Interior has welcoming front retail area and compact open rear repair alcove. Clear uninterrupted player walking aisle, sensible furniture scale, glass cases with wood frame thickness, readable silhouettes at eye level. Make it beautiful and believable as an editable modular 3D environment.
Owner constraint: the existing character is already locked and MUST NOT be redesigned. Show NO people anywhere on this board. Leave an empty fitted wooden chair at the rear repair bench for an adult owner who remains seated cross-legged, enough knee/leg space, no counter blocking the entire seat area, and an approachable customer side.
Board layout: large upper-left exterior three-quarter street view at twilight, large upper-right welcoming FIRST-PERSON EYE-HEIGHT interior from the entrance (normal lens, see entire rear workstation); small middle-left orthographic isometric roof-removed cutaway of precisely this SAME shop; bottom/middle-right clean isolated prop design studies including open/closed states, grouped on a warm ivory background. Beautiful editorial arrangement, generous spacing, prioritize two substantial scene images over tiny diagrams. The props MUST visibly match the ones placed inside the shop.
Prop studies: hinged brass pocketwatch with separated lid and readable blank/light dial, rectangular glass display case with a real hinged access door shown open, shallow watchmaker parts drawer half open with partitioned velvet trays, desk magnifier and winding key plus fine tweezers on a repair mat, paper notice on a wooden clipboard (the existing inspectable notice, paper is blank/no invented facts), aged service ledger closed and partly open (ambient proposed interaction, NOT a new narrative clue). Show physically useful hinges, handles, pivots and thickness; use restrained thin movement arrows if helpful, no game UI or glow.
Text: only a clean small header with scheme letter and short English style title, and tiny panel headings EXTERIOR / INTERIOR / LAYOUT / OBJECTS. All signboards and paper surfaces otherwise blank or simple clock emblem; no generated clue text/dates. No watermark.
Rendering: polished stylized 3D game concept art, strong designed geometry, balanced atmospheric lighting, attractive composition and crisp prop details, medium detail suited to modular modeling, not photorealistic, not crude primitives, no cyberpunk, no steampunk fantasy, no digital screens or contemporary luxury logos.

prompts.title: B / IVORY DECO
prompts.direction: Refined restrained 1931-inspired Art Deco watch boutique adapted to a small town. Ink navy painted facade, pale cream stone/plaster stepped geometric sign fascia, thin champagne brass vertical trims, broad rectangular glass windows with elegant clipped-corner timber surrounds; ONE storey, no tower or second floor. Interior has cream walls, ink-blue cabinets, blond parquet, brass geometric details, opal glass pendant, fluted wood glass display counter. Sparse precise symmetry, one compact low central vitrine with circulation both sides, rear repair alcove behind an OPEN broad rectangular arch. Make beautiful precision and restraint, not a grand hotel. Pale velvet trays and ivory leather repair surface.

prompts.title: C / BLUE WORKSHOP
prompts.direction: Light, intimate, highly crafted watch repair workshop. Dusty slate-blue timber storefront, warm weathered pale limestone base, a simple shallow pitched roof with NO upper windows or attic room, light oak canopy, squared thick window frames. Interior pale oak exposed beams, desaturated blue lower cabinets and off-white plaster, warm gray flagstone floor, blue-gray shadows, copper task light. Long clearly accessible repair bench against rear wall with empty wooden chair, small drawers and orderly hanging hand tools; sales display hugs left wall; low glass case on right; open middle aisle. Charming practical mechanical craftsmanship, precise tiny parts, minimal clutter, no giant gears decorating walls. Pale blue tool mat, oiled oak and aged brass props.

prompts.title: D / BURGUNDY ANTIQUE
prompts.direction: Intimate atmospheric collector's antique clock shop, elegant and lived-in. Deep burgundy painted storefront, muted warm stone facade, a low curved canopy, rounded-top transom within EACH of the TWO front display openings and center entrance, all arches repeated precisely inside; single storey only. Interior rich mahogany wood cabinets, muted plum upper walls, cream plaster ceiling, dark wood plank floor with a small faded patterned rug outside walking pinch points, warm amber shaded sconces. Shallow horseshoe-shaped glass counter with opening on one side, accessible rear-right repair bay and empty wooden chair, tall narrow grandfather clock against left rear wall and restrained varied wall clocks. Jewel-like brass against wine-red velvet, evocative mystery but bright enough to inspect objects. No occult symbols or fantasy machinery, no excessive distressed ruin.
